channel.title: Acme: W3C Changes
channel.description: Reports on substantive changes in W3C GitHub repositories.

item.title: W3C Internationalization Articles Add Polish Translations
item.description:
The internationalization drafts add Polish translations and include Polish in the available-version listings, expanding access to guidance on character encoding and related topics.

Changes: i18n-drafts 6acd34d8e1.

item.title: MathML Polyfill Fixes Decimal Alignment Across Number Nodes
item.description:
The MathML polyfill corrects mstack decimal alignment when a number is split across sibling mn elements. It flattens row content before locating the decimal point.

Changes: mathml-polyfills 111f332eca.

item.title: File API Serializes Blob and File Media Types
item.description:
The File API draft now includes the type attribute when serializing and deserializing Blob and File objects. This keeps MIME-type information with cloned or transferred file-like values.

Changes: FileAPI d733e1b131.

item.title: RDF Line Formats Clarify Unicode Escapes
item.description:
N-Triples excludes surrogate code points from its Unicode escape ranges, and N-Quads clarifies that lowercase hexadecimal digits are allowed. The changes align descriptions with the intended grammars.

Changes: rdf-n-triples b90a11cb9c; rdf-n-quads 5bbc21b3cc.

item.title: Credential Management Refines Active Types and Mediation
item.description:
Credential Management validates requests before marking credential types active, adds an implicitMediation internal slot, and stops request processing after a collection exception. The changes make credential-request state and failure handling more precise.

Changes: webappsec-credential-management 2ee1eef8ec; webappsec-credential-management 12567a6a3c; webappsec-credential-management ec0f009693.

item.title: Push API Corrects Subscription-Change Nullability
item.description:
Push API adds nullable types for oldSubscription and newSubscription in PushSubscriptionChangeEventInit. The change makes the event's initial values and absence of a subscription explicit in the interface.

Changes: push-api 040d5385a5.

item.title: Screen Wake Lock Checks Current Permission State
item.description:
Screen Wake Lock now queries the current permission state instead of requesting permission as part of the relevant algorithm. The change clarifies permission handling without introducing a new permission prompt.

Changes: screen-wake-lock 78f0d2a27c.

item.title: Compute Pressure Uses the Observer Receiver for Records
item.description:
Compute Pressure updates its queued-record handling to clone and empty records from the PressureObserver receiver. The correction makes delivery of pressure records more explicit.

Changes: compute-pressure 200bb98853.

item.title: VCALM Tests Cover Encryption and Workflow Requests
item.description:
The VCALM test suite adds checks for presentation request formats, workflow verifier behavior, and encrypted responses—including rejecting plaintext when encryption is required. This expands conformance coverage for draft credential exchanges.

Changes: vcalm-test-suite a8d8409c42; vcalm-test-suite d8ebbe8d92; vcalm-test-suite 9537958285; vcalm-test-suite 632d6842eb.

item.title: DID Resolution Refines Service Selection and Parameters
item.description:
DID Resolution clarifies that a service parameter matches a service-ID fragment without its leading hash, removes expandRelativeURLs, scopes HTTPS GET obligations to conforming network resolvers, and lets handlers process strategy-independent parameters. These are draft resolution semantics.

Changes: did-resolution d373abe431; did-resolution 1f0de4de31; did-resolution 1fbf77c3a5; did-resolution d55fabed1d; did-resolution f2f73f057b.

item.title: Quantum-Resistant Data Integrity Revises Disclosure Vectors
item.description:
The quantum-resistant VC Data Integrity draft updates its selective-disclosure section and test vectors, using SHoC salted hashes aggregated in a Merkle tree. This is draft cryptographic specification work.

Changes: vc-di-quantum-resistant cca4c8713f.

item.title: CSS Spatial Draft Adds Cross-Context Anchoring and Portal Resizing
item.description:
The CSS Spatial Layout draft now defines anchoring across spatial contexts, position-context: anchor, portal resizing, and named environment maps. It also clarifies positioning and adds accessibility, privacy and security considerations. This is early draft work imported into the CSS Working Group, not a shipped browser feature.

Changes: csswg-drafts 804b7b0055; csswg-drafts 9195e3f1ff; csswg-drafts 328444151a; csswg-drafts 0c8d7c5621; csswg-drafts 1995fb2a17; csswg-drafts 4c55c72406; csswg-drafts 9d2d7e2583; csswg-drafts 519aa5f041.

item.title: ActivityPub Points Implementers to ActivityStreams Context
item.description:
ActivityPub replaces a reference to an ActivityPub context with the ActivityStreams 2 context for common terms. It clarifies which JSON-LD context implementations should include in federation data.

Changes: activitypub 23423be83d.

item.title: IFT Encoder Revises Empty Glyph and Dependency Analysis
item.description:
The Incremental Font Transfer encoder tracks empty glyphs, excludes them from some segmentation decisions, and can move high-probability empty glyphs into the initial font. It also shifts closure segmentation toward interacting segments rather than older condition analysis.

Changes: ift-encoder 2252f7424e; ift-encoder b8866642bd; ift-encoder 1c8108cf68; ift-encoder b72c79213e.

item.title: CSS Pseudo Clarifies Scroll-Button Selector Text
item.description:
CSS Pseudo-Elements 4 clarifies how the argument of ::scroll-button is reflected in CSSPseudoElement.selectorText, including a selector such as ::scroll-button(left).

Changes: csswg-drafts 2aa1166724.

item.title: WCAG 3 Extends Maturity Labels to ACT Rules
item.description:
WCAG 3 work applies maturity-status levels to Accessibility Conformance Testing rules, with exploratory status as a default in the related schema. This is a draft-status tracking change, not a new WCAG conformance requirement.

Changes: wcag3 2f611d4353.

item.title: Strudy Adds Standards Syntax Checks
item.description:
The Strudy checker detects placeholder values in CSS syntaxes and recognizes the SameAgentCluster IDL extended attribute. These changes improve automated standards analysis.

Changes: strudy 47216d6ef7; strudy 54ad39bc84.

item.title: Screen Orientation Corrects Nested Updates and Lock Failure
item.description:
Screen Orientation now visits each nested document once for an orientation change and stops applying an orientation lock after platform failure. The changes prevent duplicate work and stale lock behavior.

Changes: screen-orientation 7c62dd8bc9; screen-orientation 94996a6c61.

item.title: CSS Working Group Adds Combined Specification Build
item.description:
The CSS Working Group repository adds a combiner script to build an all-CSS specification in CI. This is a documentation/build tool, not a change to CSS syntax or browser behavior.

Changes: csswg-drafts 24152e8aaf.

item.title: CSS Anchor Positioning Clarifies Important Position Tries
item.description:
CSS Anchor Positioning clarifies that an !important rule involving a position option does not invalidate the entire @position-try rule. The draft change targets cascade handling for fallback positions.

Changes: csswg-drafts 592504e15a.

item.title: CSS Forms Corrects Unchecked Control Selectors
item.description:
The CSS Forms draft corrects its selector list for unchecked checkboxes and radio buttons, including switch and indeterminate cases. This refines the proposed styling model for form controls.

Changes: csswg-drafts 58da0aa7f9.

item.title: SPARQL Protocol Drafts Refine HTTP Requirements
item.description:
SPARQL Protocol and Graph Store Protocol drafts improve normative HTTP language and examples. The edits clarify how the protocols apply HTTP requests and responses, while remaining draft specification changes.

Changes: sparql-graph-store-protocol e5c01b3e75; sparql-protocol 843f8b04d1.

item.title: SPARQL JSON Results Clarifies SELECT Head
item.description:
The SPARQL JSON Results draft explicitly defines the SELECT head as an object with a vars array and optional link or version members. Its diagram is corrected to match the prose.

Changes: sparql-results-json 16bdc6ec14.

item.title: Digital Credential Payment Method Is Proposed
item.description:
A new explainer proposes a Digital Credential Payment Method for payment flows using digital credentials. It is an initial proposal, not a standardized payment method or evidence of browser deployment.

Changes: digital-credential-payment-method cad7051e38.

item.title: Translation Matrix Improves Accessible Status Display
item.description:
The W3C translation management matrix associates data cells with table headers and adds text alternatives for status icons. These changes make translation availability easier to understand with assistive technology.

Changes: translation-management 652b6a4d5d; translation-management e919ae14c2.

item.title: Recognized Entities Test Suite Adds Validation Coverage
item.description:
A new Recognized Entities suite adds conformance cases for sections 1.1, 3 and 4, including hosted validator URLs and accepted/rejected credential paths. It provides implementation evidence infrastructure for a draft, not a finalized standard.

Changes: vc-recognized-entities-test-suite 77e8727dd6; vc-recognized-entities-test-suite b8f9011af6; vc-recognized-entities-test-suite 4ac994f1eb; vc-recognized-entities-test-suite 83907542f6; vc-recognized-entities-test-suite 7446fbac89.

item.title: Reffy Fixes Definitions with Panels
item.description:
The Reffy standards crawler now cleans generated definition panels before extracting element names. This prevents extra panel text from polluting machine-readable specification data.

Changes: reffy 9218aa2151.

item.title: SHACL UI Adds Default Ordering and Nested Groups
item.description:
SHACL UI draft work documents shui:defaultOrder for property shapes and groups, allows groups to nest through sh:group, and clarifies widget choice when a shape has no constraints. It also limits each group to at most one parent value.

Changes: data-shapes fe8f35d8dd; data-shapes 301eac24d1; data-shapes 5edcd7e720; data-shapes 7e167fd9fd.

item.title: SPARQL Service Description Adds Privacy Guidance and Link Discovery
item.description:
The Service Description draft adds privacy and security considerations about exposing service details. It also permits an HTTP Link header to point clients to a service description when the endpoint cannot serve RDF directly.

Changes: sparql-service-description 5c9733aa4d; sparql-service-description e472f338cb.

item.title: RDF Tests Improve Service Description Modeling
item.description:
The RDF/SPARQL test schema refines Service Description test modeling and negative-syntax classifications. This changes conformance-test organization, not the service-description protocol itself.

Changes: rdf-tests 92881423b5.

item.title: Vocabulary Generator Adds Accessible Mermaid Metadata
item.description:
The yml2vocab tool supports a separate Mermaid block and adds accTitle and accDescr for accessible diagram titles and descriptions. This improves generated vocabulary diagrams, not normative ontology terms.

Changes: yml2vocab a2da084432; yml2vocab d39ad5ddd4.

item.title: WAI Authoring Tools List Adds Open Journal Systems
item.description:
WAI's authoring-tools list adds Open Journal Systems with accessibility information, including caveats about preservation of alternative text during copy-and-paste. This is a resource listing, not an endorsement or WCAG rule.

Changes: wai-authoring-tools-list 6de765aa85.

item.title: Trusted Types Clarifies Default Policy and Script Text
item.description:
Trusted Types binds the expected type name before invoking a default policy and uses TrustedScript when preparing script text. The changes clarify which policy conversion and type checks apply to script sinks.

Changes: trusted-types afcdd4634f; trusted-types e2e70fb955.

item.title: Device Orientation Tightens Active-Document and Motion Rules
item.description:
Device Orientation now rejects relevant operations when a document is not fully active and uses acceleration including gravity in the motion fallback. The changes clarify lifecycle and sensor-data behavior.

Changes: deviceorientation e967851dee; deviceorientation 37f7d50330.

item.title: Geolocation Refines Cache Misses and Emulation
item.description:
Geolocation now acquires a fresh position after a cache miss, passes the Geolocation instance through acquisition steps, and limits when emulated position data wakes a watch. Together these draft changes tighten location update behavior.

Changes: geolocation bde9955b05; geolocation 2a778a432e; geolocation b12f2cd5c0.

item.title: CSS Text Adds Text Autospace Size
item.description:
CSS Text 4 introduces text-autospace-size to control the amount of space inserted by text-autospace keywords. The draft gives authors more precise typography control around mixed scripts.

Changes: csswg-drafts 0dd8e5bd91.

item.title: WoT Adds OPC Classic Protocol Bindings
item.description:
Web of Things binding templates add OPC DA, HDA and Alarms & Events bindings, align some mappings with OPC UA, restrict OPC Classic use to local COM, and remove a VQT payload from the DA binding. These are draft industrial interoperability mappings.

Changes: wot-binding-templates 85842c8ecd; wot-binding-templates abb2841d8e; wot-binding-templates dea91d8e30; wot-binding-templates 22edd93854.

item.title: VCALM Draft Defines Encrypted Presentation Options
item.description:
The VCALM draft adds acceptedEncryption to presentation requests and clarifies query groups, including missing-group behavior. It uses application/jwt for an encrypted presentation example and expands its threat-model responses. These remain evolving credential-exchange rules.

Changes: vcalm 8665239c5e; vcalm fb9dd31e0a; vcalm 9342796cd6; vcalm 0e1396cee8.

item.title: WebCodecs Defines Frame Dimensions and Track Changes
item.description:
WebCodecs adds definitions for coded size, visible rectangle, display size and stride, and assigns display dimensions during VideoFrame creation. It also consistently uses the bound track-changes list in track-update steps.

Changes: webcodecs 7c6dac6c37; webcodecs 44c642b271; webcodecs b04b2a1d02.

item.title: DID Registry Adds the cde Method
item.description:
The DID extensions registry records did:cde as a registered method. Registration identifies a method and its specification; it does not imply W3C endorsement or Recommendation status.

Changes: did-extensions 2e81a0e4a4.

item.title: Agentic AI Integration Note Remains Proposed
item.description:
The adapt repository refines an agentic-AI integration explainer and proposed W3C Note, including examples of agents discovering labeled page regions. The work describes a proposed integration pattern, not a finalized standard.

Changes: adapt b06d5fbe02.

item.title: LCP Explainer Shows Metric Calculation from Entries
item.description:
The Largest Contentful Paint explainer now walks through calculating LCP from LargestContentfulPaint entries. It helps implementers and measurement tools connect performance entries to the metric; it is explanatory material.

Changes: largest-contentful-paint 546754343d.

item.title: Second Screen Charter Begins as Draft
item.description:
A repository adds an initial draft for a proposed Second Screen Working Group charter. It is an early charter proposal, not confirmation that the proposed group or its deliverables have been approved.

Changes: secondscreen-charter 369e8e1ff4.

item.title: Service Worker Refines Routing and Registration Checks
item.description:
Service Worker static routing now tries the next cache when a chosen cache lacks a request. The draft also updates WindowClient visibility typing and checks a parsed URL's origin in getRegistration(), tightening routing and same-origin behavior.

Changes: ServiceWorker f091126bf1; ServiceWorker 7d5aa207f4; ServiceWorker 205fbd8694.

item.title: Permissions API Compares Resolved Targets
item.description:
The Permissions specification changes target comparison to use the resolved target key. This aligns permission checks with the target actually derived by the descriptor algorithm.

Changes: permissions 46a8959bd9.

item.title: CSS Color Specifies Relative Custom Spaces
item.description:
CSS Color 5 adds specification text for using a registered custom color space in relative color syntax. This is draft color-processing work, not evidence of current browser support.

Changes: csswg-drafts 9673f4e274.

item.title: Data Integrity Refines SHoC-Merkle Processing
item.description:
Verifiable Credential Data Integrity revises the SHoC-Merkle draft's label-map compression and cryptosuite processing. The work refines a developing selective-disclosure mechanism, not an already deployed interoperability guarantee.

Changes: vc-data-integrity 4cf6f33f74.

item.title: Linked Web Storage Separates OAuth Profile
item.description:
Linked Web Storage extracts OAuth-specific material from the core protocol into a separate OAuth Profile draft. The division distinguishes the base storage protocol from one authorization profile.

Changes: lws-protocol c3538e8d5b.

item.title: SOSA Clarifies Observed Property as an Individual
item.description:
SOSA/SSN now specifies that observedProperty and actsOnProperty point to an individual of sosa:Property, not a class. The clarification guides consistent modeling of sensor and actuator properties.

Changes: sdw-sosa-ssn 49a0fd94ba.

item.title: CSS Shapes Defines Contours Through Border Paths
item.description:
CSS Borders and Shapes drafts define inner and outer shape-box contours through the border contour path algorithm. The change aligns geometry used by shapes with border rendering.

Changes: csswg-drafts f7c312957e.

item.title: SHACL Core Warns About Validation-Report Privacy
item.description:
SHACL Core adds a warning that validation reports can reveal graph content through values and result messages when users may run validation without permission to inspect the underlying graph. Implementations should consider report access alongside data access.

Changes: data-shapes 807efba7be.

item.title: Trusted Types Unwraps Values Outside Protected Sinks
item.description:
The Trusted Types draft clarifies that setting an attribute that is not a Trusted Types sink returns the underlying data of a Trusted Type value. This avoids applying sink-specific handling to ordinary attributes.

Changes: trusted-types a280ec2245.

item.title: Credential Management Refines Reauthentication and Creation
item.description:
Credential Management examples now await reauthentication before form submission. The draft also links credential creation to AbortSignal handling and compares credential-type identifiers as strings, improving algorithmic consistency.

Changes: webappsec-credential-management d322c4f249; webappsec-credential-management 3d292a9892; webappsec-credential-management ead9f78b70.

item.title: SOSA/SSN Clarifies System and Domain Modeling
item.description:
SOSA/SSN guidance aligns system-instance examples with the recommended system-type pattern, recommends reusing suitable catalogue properties before inventing new ones, and says subclassing FeatureOfInterest is permissible when intended.

Changes: sdw-sosa-ssn ffd7892901; sdw-sosa-ssn b605530fe7; sdw-sosa-ssn e363e0b16f.

item.title: Push API Revises Event Data and Subscription Algorithms
item.description:
Push API draft changes handle null PushEvent data, skip non-map declarative actions, remove vibration from declarative notifications, and clarify asynchronous subscription promise settlement and scope matching. These related commits sharpen push-delivery and subscription behavior.

Changes: push-api 6947efdf43; push-api a236755239; push-api 883db62269; push-api 92f9b3ccb6; push-api 72ad7cffd4; push-api 692ab067d3; push-api 9c5bfbe6b8.
